title: handoff
description: The handoff the engine writes for the proposer at the start of every pass with `carry.ledger_handoff` on (F103-FR-041). It crosses a FILE boundary — the engine writes it, the proposer reads it through its prompt — and therefore has its schema in @specstride/contracts, unlike the request and the result of the pass loop, which are a call. The file is regenerated every time and never appended to, is at most `carry.handoffMaxBytes` bytes (6 KB), is never read back by the runtime, and is refused by grounding (F100-FR-037). No model writes any part of it, and every text in it that comes from the workspace is data. Feature 103 (T003); the field list is F103-FR-041 and the table "Handoff" of specs/103-proposer-pass/data-model.md, and the specification stands where the two differ.

phase.description: The phase the handoff was built for

phaseAttempt.description: The number of the phase attempt

counters.description: The counters as they stand when the handoff is written: the pass index, the yield index, the error count, the cap count, the no-progress count and the short-pass count, and the outer-loop counts the engine adds (F103-FR-040)

ledgerTail.description: The last lines of the ledger, oldest first, as text

remainingUnits.description: The remaining units of work: the plan less the ledger

id.description: The id of the unit of work

title.description: The title of the unit of work, cut as the index cuts its titles

killNote.description: The newest kill note. After a kill it names the unit of work that was in progress, where a layer declared one; the runtime changes no file of the tree for it (F103-FR-041)

unitInProgress.description: The unit of work that was in progress, where a layer declared one

text.description: The note itself. Text that comes from the workspace; framed as data

detachedJob.description: The `on_resume` text and the result of a detached job

onResume.description: The `on_resume` text, handed back verbatim. Text that comes from the workspace; framed as data

exitCode.description: The exit code of the job, where it ended

log.description: A bounded slice of the job's log. Text that comes from the workspace; framed as data

feedbackPointers.description: The pointers to the feedback files, by logical name. The handoff holds the pointers, never the critic's text

treeFingerprint.description: The fingerprint of the tree the handoff was built against

treeWins.description: The line that says the tree wins where the handoff and the tree disagree (F103-FR-041)

maxBytes.description: The byte ceiling the file was rendered under, `carry.handoffMaxBytes` (6144)

truncated.description: True when the rendered file was cut at the last complete line under the ceiling, with the marker
